Method of Attack: Rewriting the hard drive MBR (Master Boot Record) with images
Using hardcoded login credentials to spread quickly and wipe data
Using EldoS RawDisk driver to access hard drive without Windows OS interaction
Pre-configured malware with embedded components (dropper, communications, wiper)
Timing attacks to coincide with weekends and Muslim holidays to maximize impact
Impacted Systems: Computers in Saudi Arabian companies, including Aramco
Indicators of Compromise: IP 1.1.1.1 (used as a neutered C&C server address)
Image of a burning US flag (2012 attack)
Image of Alan Kurdi, Syrian boy (2016 attack)
